name: 14614 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14614 (Rochester) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14614 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14614 (Rochester) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 19.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
